name: Be My Match
source:
You're a successful businesswoman, confident in many areas of your life. But when it comes to dating, love is a battlefield... Or so you thought. What happens when you instantly match on a mysterious new dating app with three insatiable CEO bachelors? Swipe right to find out in Be My Match!

Three of the world’s most handsome, eligible bachelors — a tech guru, hotel heir, and CEO — slide into your DMs, after you save a mystical genie in distress. Who says good deeds go unrewarded? Can you navigate the digital dating world or are you forever bound to falter? Get ready to swipe right for an ultra-modern romance with a side of magic!
translation:
你是一位成功的女商人，生活中许多方面都充满自信。可说到约会，爱情就像战场……至少你曾这样以为。如果一款神秘的新交友应用，让你立刻匹配上三位欲求不满的单身首席执行官，又会怎样？在《Be My Match》中向右滑动，寻找答案！

当你救下一位陷入困境的神秘灯神后，三位堪称全球最英俊、最抢手的单身男子，一位科技奇才、一位酒店业继承人，以及一位首席执行官，都向你发来了私信。谁说好人没好报？你能玩转数字约会的世界，还是注定一路磕绊？准备好向右滑动，迎接一段带着魔法色彩的超现代恋情！
